why: CLDR supplies currency validity intervals, which lag a currency change by a release or more; a dated manual change belongs here and takes precedence. `overrides` replaces the fetched list whole. It is also what holds a curated list still: upstream reports the Kiribati and Tuvalu dollars, which have no ISO code and therefore no name in any locale, and would reach a player as an answer option reading ‚KID‘. A country listing more than one code is listing them in the order a player reads. `missingUpstream` is the other direction: a code for a country the reference database has no currency for at all. Micronesia is the only one — `world-countries` records no currency for it, and the country uses the US dollar.
